subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should the canonical fix for this issue be the broader approval-flow repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498, the narrow timeout-only repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94315, or the Codex watchdog-side repair path represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the repair changes an approval/security boundary and the active PRs choose different ownership points for timeout semantics.

options.title: Use the broader approval-flow repair
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical path if maintainers want proposal metadata, bounded approval, and non-wedging timeout results handled together.

options.title: Take the timeout-only repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94315 only if maintainers prefer the smallest apply-specific timeout change and accept that popup metadata and timeout wording stay separate.

options.title: Repair the Codex watchdog boundary
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325 or the broader plugin-timeout discussion if maintainers want the outer Codex dynamic-tool budget to own this class of failures.

recommendation.title: Use the broader approval-flow repair
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical path if maintainers want proposal metadata, bounded approval, and non-wedging timeout results handled together.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this issue and authored the broader open PR that closes this issue and the adjacent approval-popup issue.
